name: print-social-laughing-crowd-photo-with-indigo-panel-whats-new-cover
title: Laughing Photo with Indigo What's New Panel
whatItIs: An Instagram carousel cover that splits a close-up of a laughing man in cream sunglasses at an outdoor event above a solid indigo panel with a faint arc pattern, the heading 'What's New on Tix?', a short line, the site name and an outlined SWIPE pill.
whatItMeans: A joyful face on top and a clear panel below make an update feel human, and the notch in the panel corner adds a designed detail.
techniques: Photo on top and colour panel below
Large light headline in white on indigo
Cut corner where photo meets panel
Outlined swipe pill as the cue
Faint concentric arc pattern on the panel

vocabulary.definition: A cover divided into a photo area and a text panel.
An outlined capsule prompting the next slide.
Concentric curves used as a subtle texture.
